failure_summary: Run 2 wrapped "c6r3" — the better move's own landing cell (prompt Decision block: "Better move: column 6 (lands at c6r3)") and opponentPunishment.entryCell — inside the required [zone:opp-fork-pivot] whose spec is future:c7r3, so the guard failed it (P6:raw_coordinate:future:c7r3) and stripped the span, serving "...the fork turning on column 5, row 3 and column 7, row 4 after column 6", which is board-false (visualize_board on render_decision.finalMovestring 33333111155051310020002242224555666 shows move 35 = c7r3 is what makes c5r3 and c7r4 simultaneously gravity-top, while c6r3 is move 13); run 0 separately omitted the required handle [zone:you-key-square] and attributed the opponent's double threat to the after-BEST line, where projectedDeep (3333311115550520030001122222445566666644) shows only a single opponent major at c5r5 and lostResource.tacticTag is null. Both are model-side mis-anchoring of information that IS present and unambiguous in the assembled prompt — and because these rows are gpt-5.4-mini, the model production ships, this is a PRODUCTION-FIDELITY run, so prompt_confusion here cannot be separated from model capability; it is not an assertion of a prompt defect.
